extensionDescription.message: Turns Google Meet's live captions into a transcript you can copy or download. Works with Polish and English meetings.

statusNotMeeting.message: Open a Google Meet meeting to record a transcript.

statusNeedsReload.message: Reload the Meet tab to finish setting up the extension.

captionsOff.message: Meet's captions are off. Starting the recording switches them on.

captionsNotFound.message: Meet's captions button was not found. Switch captions on in Meet, then start.

captionLanguageHint.message: The transcript language follows Meet's caption language (Settings → Captions).
